from collections import defaultdict

test_1s = [(2,2), (4,14), (10,10), (17,9)]
test_6s = [(4,4), (6,6), (7,14), (15,2)]

def create_solution():
    rows, cols = 19, 16
    solution = [[4]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    # Group 6s by their r-c
    r_diffs_6 = defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in test_6s:
        r_diffs_6[r-c].append((r,c))
    
    # Group 1s by their r-c
    r_diffs_1 = defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in test_1s:
        r_diffs_1[r-c].append((r,c))
    
    # For 6s: fill main diagonal between consecutive 6s on same r-diff
    for r_diff in r_diffs_6:
        sorted_pos = sorted(r_diffs_6[r_diff], key=lambda p: p[0])
        for r,c in sorted_pos:
            solution[r][c] = 6  # place all input 6s
        # Fill between consecutive 6s
        for i in range(len(sorted_pos) - 1):
            r1, c1 = sorted_pos[i]
            r2, c2 = sorted_pos[i+1]
            # Fill diagonal between them
            for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):  # skip r1, include r2
                cr = r - r_diff
                if 0 <= cr < cols and solution[r][cr] == 4:
                    solution[r][cr] = 6
    
    # For 1s: fill main diagonal between consecutive 1s on same r-diff
    for r_diff in r_diffs_1:
        sorted_pos = sorted(r_diffs_1[r_diff], key=lambda p: p[0])
        for r,c in sorted_pos:
            solution[r][c] = 1  # place all input 1s
        # Fill between consecutive 1s
        for i in range(len(sorted_pos) - 1):
            r1, c1 = sorted_pos[i]
            r2, c2 = sorted_pos[i+1]
            # Fill diagonal between them (respects 6 priority implicitly)
            for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                cr = r - r_diff
                if 0 <= cr < cols and solution[r][cr] == 4:
                    solution[r][cr] = 1
    
    return solution

sol = create_solution()

count_4 = sum(1 for row in sol for cell in row if cell == 4)
print(f"Stats: {count_1} ones, {count_6} sixes, {count_4} fours (total={count_1+count_6+count_4})")

print(f"\n1 positions:")

raw_1s = [[4]*16 for _ in range(19)]
for r,c in test_1s:
    raw_1s[r][c] = 1
    # Fill main diagonal r-c
    d = r-c
    # Forward scan from this position
    r_start = r
    while r_start + 1 < 19 and 0 <= (r_start + 1) - d < 16:
        if raw_1s[r_start+1][(r_start+1)-d] == 4:
            raw_1s[r_start+1][(r_start+1)-d] = 1
        r_start += 1
    # Backward scan
    while r_start - 1 >= 0 and 0 <= (r_start-1) - d < 16:
        if raw_1s[r_start-1][(r_start-1)-d] == 4:
            raw_1s[r_start-1][(r_start-1)-d] = 1
        r_start -= 1

# Create 6-solution
test_6s = [(4,4), (6,6), (7,14), (15,2)]
raw_6s = [[raw_1s[r][c] for c in range(16)] for r in range(19)]  # copy
for r,c in test_6s:
    raw_6s[r][c] = 6
    # Fill anti-diagonal r+c
    s = r+c
    # Forward/Backward scan
    r_iter = [r]
    while True:
        for dr in [1, -1]:
            nr = r_iter[-1] + dr
            nc = s - nr
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 16:
                if raw_6s[nr][nc] == 4:  # Only fill background

                    r_iter.append(nc) if False else None
            else:

        if all(nr < 0 or nr >= 19 for r_iter[-1], nc in zip(r_iter[1:], [s-nc for nc in [s-n for r,n in r_iter]])):
            break

# Overwrite with 6s (priority)
for r,c in test_6s:
    raw_6s[r][c] = 6

# Count ones
count_1 = sum(1 for row in raw_6s for cell in row if cell == 1)
count_6 = sum(1 for row in raw_6s for cell in row if cell == 6)
print(f"Count 1: {count_1}, Count 6: {count_6}")

# Print grid
for r in range(19):
    line = ''
    for c in range(16):
        if raw_6s[r][c] == 1:
            line += '1 '
        elif raw_6s[r][c] == 6:
            line += '6 '
        else:
            line += '4 '
    print(line)
